title: Houthi attacks on Saudi civilian and economic sites
reason: Reuters and AP report 73 injuries and attacks on Saudi sites, but the inspected evidence does not yet establish a resulting U.S. action or direct Trump-administration lifecycle change.
recheck_trigger: A verified U.S. military or diplomatic response, formal commitment, or credible evidence directly connecting the attacks to an existing U.S. operation.

title: Reported armed confrontation involving U.S. deportees in Equatorial Guinea
reason: Reuters reviewed video and interviewed witnesses, including a named deportee, but the preceding events and consequential armed-confrontation account lacked a second independent confirmation or official incident record by cutoff.
recheck_trigger: A second independent outlet, official incident record, court filing or named-party documentation confirms the confrontation and its connection to the U.S. third-country deportation arrangement.
